greet.text: A Deepfolk trader behind a stall on the Market Bridge, with a fur collar, a scale of her own, and the dark of the chasm a step behind her. "Grima Coldiron. Ingots, tools, a tome or two the Seal College would rather I didn't sell. Everything weighed on my own scales, so don't ask about Pell's."

bridge.text: "Oldest law in the mountain: no guild owns the bridge. Every other stone in Karrowdeep belongs to someone. Out here over the dark, nobody, so anybody can sell." She shrugs. "And if a customer argues, the drop settles it."
